name: Movie Mashup
storyline: Sometime after the events of the original SpongeBob SquarePants Movie game, Mindy asks for SpongeBob's help yet again. At the same time, Patrick is dealing with a super ultra very deep depression. The two embark on a journey across various worlds to improve Patrick's mental state and solve the mystery behind Mindy's cry for help.
summary: Movie Mashup is a complete level hack of The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie game, featuring completely original level sets and a new story set loosely after the original. It boasts new stage gimmicks, enemies, puzzles, and more to where it's closer to a complete overhaul with the same fundamental mechanics.
